person.about_me:
Higgs' purpose is to have a positive impact upon our people, our clients, our business partners and our community by forging long-term relationships.

Our fantastic (award winning) teams support our purpose by delivering excellent legal services to a balance of business, family and individual clients designed to increase their personal wealth, support their business objectives and/or protect their wellbeing. 

As Managing Partner, I am passionate about building long-term relationships and about the role the firm plays in our community. I seek to do this by taking a background of playing many team sports, and add (what I hope is) a healthy dose of competition and (importantly) fun. Higgs LLP is an award-winning law firm, employing approaching 250 people, based in prestigious offices in Brierley Hill. Recognised across the Midlands and nationally, we are proud of our heritage and reputation for consistently delivering exceptional standards of service.  Clients work with Higgs year after year because we deliver results with integrity - we deliver what we say we will, time after time. 

Whether you’re looking for the next career move or seeking legal advice, please do not hesitate to get in touch for a conversation.

person.about_me:

I'm a Business Growth and Leadership Development Consultant, with over 25 years of senior leadership and team building experience in the HEOR/HTA/Market Access sector. 

I’m passionate about leadership development, team building, and the power of shared learning / continuous professional development. It’s always a joy when you see people on your team grow and develop, and visibly thrive in the challenge of a developing a leadership career. 

A lot of my time is focused on supporting people to navigate and develop on their careers journeys, through a focus on self-awareness, and an understanding of others.  

For teams to be highly-functioning it is essential leaders / consultants feel:

•	Empowered, in the work they do and skills they have developed
•	Connected, in professional relationships and collaborations
•	Safe, in proposing new approaches and taking measured risks
•	Valued, in understanding their role and that of others
•	Genuine, in being true to their nature, honing their own style

I support teams in four key areas of business / commercial focus:

⭐	𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 𝐃𝐘𝐍𝐀𝐌𝐈𝐂𝐒 / 𝐂𝐎𝐋𝐋𝐀𝐁𝐎𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍, on how to best work effectively in mixed discipline teams, to be curious, to be adaptive, and to have a shared focus 

⭐	𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐒𝐎𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐄𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐕𝐄𝐍𝐄𝐒𝐒, on how to understand and manage individual preferences, understand likely triggers and conflicts, to value differences in others without judgement, understand how preferences show up in the workplace, and to modify personal styles.

⭐	𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐒𝐇𝐈𝐏 𝐄𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐕𝐄𝐍𝐄𝐒𝐒, on how to build and maintain healthy leadership habits and instincts, developing a clear personal style, while being able to deliver on the core needs of a leadership role.
